Caline Caline CP-500 series browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive distortion browse by enclosure pedal Caline CP-515 Carmilla - Hi Gain Distortion Machine Published on December 4, 2023 Caline CP-500 series distortion pedal Information Caline CP-500 series Introducing "Carmilla" to the Caline 500 Series. This "Hi Gain Distortion Machine" is a great-looking and incredibly responsive distortion pedal. Using the Presence and Distortion control it's possible to go from a light boost, through to a classic rock crunch. If you're brave enough to max out Carmila it will take you to a place of incredibly intense and responsive heavy distortion. Definitely not for the faint-hearted! The CP-515 will be a versatile and enjoyable addition to any pedal board. Don't hold back! As with all Caline pedals the CP-515 has a durable metal construction combined with a True Bypass design.
